C1548.title: IEEE Paper Explores Royalty-Friendly Transactions and Bypass Issues on Blockchains
C1548.summary: A 2023 IEEE paper titled "Royalty-friendly digital asset exchanges on blockchains" identifies challenges in royalty distribution for software-licensed NFTs, emphasizing the need to prevent malicious users from bypassing rules at the blockchain level to protect creator earnings.
